tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// klong gsal rdor snying gi khro bo dang mkha' 'gro sme brtsegs gnyis kyi sgrub rjes bzhugs yod/

1$0000250klong gsal rdo rje'i snying po las: khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa'i sgrub pa bzhugs:1$0000300 rdo rje'i snying po las: khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa'i sgrub pa ni: ye shes lha la phyag 'tshal lo: ྈྈྈྈ ma 'ongs 'gro rnams 'dun stabs nyes pa'i grib: dam nyams zas gos gnas rdzas ro bag sogs: grib kyi nyes pas sgo gsum nyams gyur na: khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs pa'i gdams pa bstan: sa ma ya: dkyil 'khor padmas mtshan pa nyi ma'i steng: lha 'am phyag mtshan snying po mtshon byed bcas: gtor ma gru gsum dmar nag me 'bar ba: phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba bsham: hūm̐: pad nyi'i steng du skad cig dran rdzogs kyis: khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa ni: mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs khro gnyer bsdus: zhal rer spyan ni gsum gsum rab tu gdangs: sma ra smin ma dmar ser me ltar 'bar: dbu skra ral pa kham ser gyen du brdzes: rdo rje rgya gram rtse lnga lcags kyu g.yas: rdo rje'i dbyug pa zhags pa sdigs mdzub g.yon: phyogs bcur phyar zhing rang 'dra'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: rab khros zhabs gnyis nyi ma'i steng du bgrad: sku las me 'bar gsung las sngags sgra sgrog: thugs stobs nyams grib thul pa'i skur gyur to: bzlas pa ni: āom̐ bhur kuṃ ma hā prā ṇa ye: bhur tsi bhurki bi ma le: u tsuṣma kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa: āom̐ bhur kuṃ ri li sha: thar sha hur shi bi ma le u tsuṣma kro dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ yig las: ye shes me yi tshwa tshwa 'phros: bskor zhing 'khor ba'i rig mdangs kyis: nyams grib thul ba'i ngo bor gyur: rig dang rig mdangs mdun bum bskyed: spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal yongs kyi stobs 'dus ni: ye shes rtsal gyi zer mnga' ba'i: rab khros sme brtsegs 'khor dang bcas: 'gro ba'i don du spyan 'dren no:

badzra sa ma ya dza dza: bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: rab khros khro rgyal thugs rje can: 'gro ba'i don du byon pa legs: bdag sogs byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir: dkyil 'khor gsum dang dbyer med bzhugs: sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: bdag sogs mgon dang bskyab phyir du: thugs rjes skyong bar rab bskul phyir: sgo gsum dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: 'gro ba'i sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: mchod 'bul ni: hūm̐: ye shes lha la gtsang sme'i rtog bral yang: bdag sogs bsod nams ye shes mchog thob phyir: sna tshogs mchod pa khro rgyal dgyes phyir 'bul: 'gro kun tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs sangs rgyas shog: āom̐ badzra arghaṃ sogs nas shabda: rū pa: shabda: gandhe: ra sa: sparshe: ma hā pañtsa a mṛta rakta ba liṃ ta khā hi: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: zhi bas gdul dka' drag po'i phrin las bdag: mthu stobs rngams pas 'gro ba'i nad sel ba'i: drag po khros pa'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs: dpal mgon thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces sngags bzla: 1$0000250༁ྃ: rjes su 'jug pa rjes gnang ni: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ1$0000300 khrus dang maṇḍal gsol ba 'debs: khrus bya ba ni bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: rin chen bum pa'i gzhal yas na: sme ba brtsegs pa'i thugs rje'i chus: skal ldan khyod la khrus bgyis pas: nyams grib mi gtsang dag gyur cig: rtsa sngags: sarba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: maṇḍal gsol ba 'debs pa ni: e ma 'dren pa bka' drin can: bdag sogs ma rig bag chags mthus: nyams grib skyon gyis gos gyur na: sel ba'i gdams pa bstsal du gsol: zhus pas slob dpon gyis: ho: ma rig rgyu las rkyen bskyed de: thar pa'i lam bzang sgrib nus na: zhi mdzad khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs: mchog gi gdams pa 'di zungs shig: ces gnang ba sbyin te: bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: bum pa'i zhing na lha yi bcud: nus pa ye shes bdud rtsi 'dis:

skal ldan lus kyi dri dag nas: khro rgyal sku ru 'grub par shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa āom̐: bzlas lung sbyin la: hūm̐: slob dpon sme ba brtsegs pa yi: snying po'i rang mdangs yig 'bru'i skur: slob ma sme ba brtsegs la thim: gsung nus grib sel sngags la dbang: rtsa sngags: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: rdo rje rgya gram thugs kar bzhag la: hūm̐: khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs pa yi: drag po'i phrin las rang mdangs kyis: skal ldan yid la dbang bskur ro: yid sgrib dag nas thugs dbang rdzogs: rtsa sngags: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sku gtad la: hūm̐: khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs pa'i sku: yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa yis: 'gro ba sdug bsngal las grol ba'i: don dbang yongs rdzogs thob par shog: rtsa sngags: sarba gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: phyag mtshan sna tshogs gtad la: hūm̐: rdo rje rgya gram las bzhi sgrub: rdo rje rtse lnga thugs rig 'bar: rdo rje thugs rje'i lcags kyus 'dzin: thugs rjes drangs la rdo rje dbyug: brtse ba'i rdo rje'i zhags pa dang: gang la gang 'dul rtsal rdzogs kyi: phrin las lhun gyis grub par shog: rtsa sngags: shāntiṃ puṣṭiṃ wa shaṃ mā ra ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: maṇḍal bsrung yul dam tshig dang: rjes kyi bya ba tshul ji bzhin: rgyun gyi lam khyer bskyed bzlas rnams: 'gro la sems bskyed dang blang byos: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes khol ri gsang sngags sgrub khang rtser klong gsal snying pos zhal bshus pa'i yi ge pa ni stobs chen no/// / 1$0000250༁ྃ: klong gsal rdo rje'i snying po las: mkha' 'gro sme brtsegs kyi sgrub pa bzhugs so: 1$0000300 klong gsal rdo rje'i snying po las: yan lag gi sgrub pa ni: gang zhig lus la grib kyis phog gyur na: lus rgud ngag dig sems kyi rang rtsal nyams: tshe 'dir mi rung sna dgu thog tu bab: phyi ma thar pa'i lam yang sgrib nus na: de phyir mkha' 'gro sme ba brtsegs pa bsgrub:

sgrub pa'i rten du bum pa mtshan ldan nang: gla rtsi chu dag dbang lag gu gul dang: gzhan yang bum rdzas spyi dang mthun par blugs: phyi 'khor mchod pa'i bye brag 'byor tshad bsham: bhrūm̐ las gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dbus: stong pa'i ngang las rang sems hūm̐ mthing las: me 'bar dngos 'dzin mtshan ma'i nyams grib bsregs: tshur 'dus rang nyid mkha' 'gro sme brtsegs ni: sku mdog mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: phyag g.yas chos 'byung dmar po nam mkhar gdengs: g.yon pas khrus bum mthing ga thugs kar 'dzin: zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum rol pas 'gying: thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ yig mthar: rtsa ba'i gsang sngags snying po 'di yis bskor: āom̐ ghar khaṃ tsir khaṃ bhi mā na se u tsus mo kro tī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: mdun bskyed bum pa'i dbus su gong bzhin gyi: tha mar 'byung ba'i lha mo rnam lnga yi: phyag na bdud rtsi'i khrus bum bsnams par bsgom: hūm̐: phyogs dus zhing gi sangs rgyas byang sems kyi: thugs rje'i zer mdangs khro mo'i skur gyur nas: dam tshig sems dpa' 'di la gnyis med du: thim nas 'gro ba'i nyams grib bsal du gsol: badzra sa ma ya dza dza: a ti pū ho: pra ti dza ho: arghaṃ sogs pū dza ho brjod: hūm̐: dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las bdag: 'gro ba'i nyams grib ma lus zhi mdzad pa'i: mkha' 'gro'i rgyal mo sme ba brtsegs ma zhes: lha mchog thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal bstod: khyod kyi 'khor tshogs 'byung ba'i lha mo lnga: dag byed khrus kyi bum pa phyag na bsnams: nyams grib mi gtsang dri ma 'khrud par mdzad: dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsnyen pa ni: āom̐ ghar khaṃ tsir khaṃ bhi mā na se u tsus mo kro tī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: lha sngags sham bu: āom̐ āḥhūm̐: e baṃ laṃ raṃ yaṃ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya: e ho shuddhe shuddhe:

baṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe: laṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe: raṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe: yaṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe: e baṃ laṃ raṃ yaṃ shuddhe shuddhe bi ma le bi mā na se a a a: gang zhig bdag sogs rnam g.yeng dbang song na: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod bstod bzlas pa dang: sngags dang ting 'dzin ma tshang yal ba sogs: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la mthol zhing bshags: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dang 'gal gyur na: bzod par bzhes la tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: sa ma ya: ma mo gza' dang rdo rje legs pas srungs shig: sa ma ya: zhes snying gi grogs po padma mkha' spyod kyis bskul ba la brten nas bdag nyid klong gsal snying pos dag par phab pa'o/// / 1$0000250༁ྃ: klong gsal rdo rje'i snying po las: mkha' 'gro sme brtsegs kyi rjes gnang bzhugs so: 1$0000300 klong gsal rdo rje'i snying po las: mkha' 'gro sme brtsegs kyi rjes gnang ni: dkyil 'khor bum pa me long rma bya'i mdongs: bsnyen pa dang cho ga'i bya ba rdzogs par byas nas: slob mar rjes su gnang ba'i bya ba ni: maṇḍal phul la gsol ba 'debs pa ni: kye: bla ma gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin: bdag cag ma rig grib khru phyir: mkha' 'gro sme ba brtsegs ma yi: rjes su gnang ba bstsal du gsol: ye shes dbab nas dam tshig brtan par bya: tiṣṭha badzra hūm̐: bum pa gtad la: hūm̐: rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis bum pa na: mkha' 'gro'i rgyal mo sme ba brtsegs ma bzhugs: skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas: sme ba brtsegs ma'i sku yi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: slob dpon yang tha mal pa ma lags par mkha' 'gro'i rgyal mo sme ba brtsegs mar gsal: khyod rang yang sme brtsegs su sgoms shig: slob dpon gyi thugs kar hūm̐ yig mthing nag la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od zer slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon: khyod rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim pa'i mos pa gyis:

bzlas lung sbyin: rtsa sngags sham bu bcas rjes zlos kyi smon lam sogs brtan par byed: hūm̐: 'gyur med rig pa'i rdo rje 'di: ye shes me yi zer dang bcas: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: khro rgyal thugs kyi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las rang byung ba'i: sreg byed me dang bkru byed chu: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: nyams grib mi gtsang dag gyur cig: maṇḍal phul la: deng nas brtsam ste bdag bran du: khyod la bdag nyid 'bul lags na: khyod kyis slob mar gzung ba dang: cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol: gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi: sogs dang bkra shis bya'o: ma mo gza' dang rdo rje legs pas srungs shig: sa ma ya: zhes grogs kyi mchog gyur padma mkha' spyod kyis bskul ba'i ngor bdag gter ston klong gsal snying pos dag par phab pa'o/// /
